main_text.head: DE RE ECCLE-SIASTICA IN URBE.
main_text.p: Res eccle-siastica in urbe.Sic Civilia: restat ut Ecclesiastica perstringam. Solent in urbe esse, ut in principio ostendi, parochiae tres cum totidem sanis. In his sacerdotes sacris operantes numero XXI: in quibus pastores tres singuli in sanis ac parochiis. Tandem anno M. CCCC. LXXX unus ex his editus velut ἐφορῷ[?] totius rei ecclesiasticae in urbe & urbis vicinia, quem PERSONAM more suo vocabant: isque erat velut minor quidam episcopus, aut episcopi vicem gerens, magna potestate & multis privilegiis ornatus a Romano Pontifice. Hunc caeteri pastores, & duo seniores urbis consules eligebant, & in munus suum immittebant, in magnoque honore habebat tota civitas. Deinde anno M. D. LXVIII, cum mutatio-nibus Belgicis via divinitus strueretur, novique episcopatus passim in his regionibus instituerentur, episcopus quoque huic

page.notes: The running head "Groninga" ends in a letter that may be a ligature; read as printed. The page number is printed with an old-style 9 and read as 249. The Greek word after "velut" is faint and only partly legible; the reading ἐφορῷ is uncertain. "fanis" is printed with a long s, transcribed as "sanis". "PERSONAM" is set in spaced capitals. The printed hyphen in "ECCLE-" and "mutatio-" is kept. The faint text at the bottom right of the scan is a digitiser's credit and is not transcribed.
